en.headline: Cyberport Phase 5 offices more than half leased after June completion
en.dek: Chairman Simon Chan said the expansion adds 66,000 square metres including a Tier-III+ data centre, with tenants such as Lenovo and BrainCo already moved in.
body: Hong Kong’s Cyberport has filled more than half of the office space in its fifth-phase expansion, which was completed in June, according to chairman Simon Chan Sai-ming.

Speaking on Saturday, Mr Chan said the project, allocated HK$5.5 billion in the 2019 Budget, sits on a 1.6-hectare waterfront site in Pok Fu Lam and comprises a 10-storey tower with about 66,000 square metres of gross floor area. Of that, roughly 36,000 square metres is dedicated to offices and co-working space, while about 8,600 square metres houses a Tier-III+ data centre supporting the hub’s AI supercomputing facilities.

Major tenants including Lenovo and brain-computer interface firm BrainCo have already moved in. Mr Chan said the expansion positions Cyberport as a key driver in the city’s first five-year plan by advancing artificial intelligence as a pillar industry, expanding talent training and improving cross-border data governance.

zh.headline: 數碼港第五期寫字樓出租率逾五成 聯想等企業進駐
zh.dek: 董事局主席陳細明表示，六月竣工的擴建項目新增約六萬六千平方米，包括數據中心，目前寫字樓出租率已過半。
body: 香港數碼港管理有限公司董事局主席陳細明周六表示，數碼港第五期擴建工程已於今年六月底竣工，寫字樓出租率已超過百分之五十。
陳細明稱，項目於二○一九年《財政預算案》獲撥款五十五億元，位於薄扶林約一點六公頃海傍用地，為一幢十層高大樓，總樓面面積約六萬六千平方米。當中約三萬六千平方米為寫字樓及共用工作空間，另有約八千六百平方米符合Tier-III+級別的數據中心，支援人工智能超算設施。
主要租戶包括聯想及腦機介面企業BrainCo等已進駐。陳細明表示，第五期有助數碼港在香港首份五年規劃中推動人工智能成為支柱產業，並加強人才培訓及跨境數據管治。
